A key take-away for me is that the NixOS paradigm conflicts with the auto-updaters of big IDEs like VSCode, , . Every time the OS has an update, it requires Nix-OS-specific workarounds. As a result, Forrest moved from NixOS to omakub, which is Person/David Heinemeier Hansson's opinionated Ubuntu setup. Given Forrest's prior affection for , he's closely watching DHH's Omarchy.

lq, short for logseq-query, is a commandline tool for querying logseq knowledge graphs. lq makes it easy to define custom datalog queries and rules and invoke them from the commandline. Rules and queries are just EDN data and can be composed to make complex queries easy to read and write.
